brief: Luminescent crystals hang from the cave ceiling as glowing stalactites and slowly drip onto the floor below. The crystals pulsate with an inner light, casting shifting colored shadows on the cavern walls. Mouse movements guide a glowing orb that sweeps across the scene, illuminating different crystal formations while dragging reveals hidden veins of color within the rock. The depth of the cave expands and contracts subtly to reveal distant chambers when the cursor interacts with the space.

A glowing orb follows mouse movements, illuminating different crystal formations while dragging reveals hidden color veins within the rock. The cave depth subtly expands and contracts to suggest vast underground chambers, with particles falling from the ceiling to simulate sediment accumulation.
